stories.title: Ed Sheeran tour controversy prompts Gaza aid pledges from Macklemore, Kraft, Sheeran
new_facts: Establishes story: Macklemore pledges millions to Palestinian aid, Kraft matches after Macklemore's public challenge.
Specifies Kraft's donation figure ($2m) and quotes him saying Sheeran personally asked him to give it.
Specifies Macklemore's donation amount as $1 million from his Loop Tour earnings.
Reveals Macklemore was dropped from the tour after making a 'free Palestine' statement onstage.
Reports four supporting acts dropped out of the tour citing free speech, widening the dispute into an antisemitism debate.
Specifies Kraft said Macklemore wouldn't be welcome at Gillette Stadium shows scheduled for late September.
stories.line: Musicians and sports figures announce Gaza donations after Macklemore's removal from Ed Sheeran tour sparked public dispute over Palestinian aid.

new_facts: Trump to meet Gulf leaders at UN General Assembly next Tuesday to discuss Iran war next steps
Trump claims US is nearing end of Iran war and asserts direct talks with Tehran are occurring
stories.line: Trump plans meetings with Gulf leaders on Iran policy as administration signals the nuclear issue is resolved.

stories.title: House passes Russia sanctions bill, advances data-center cost limits
new_facts: New story: Congress passes Russia sanctions bill, first pro-Ukraine legislation in over two years.
Bill also targets Iran and is named for late Sen. Lindsey Graham who championed it.
Graham died suddenly after announcing a deal with the White House; bill overcame Democratic opposition.
Bill could trigger secondary sanctions on India, China, and Iran; called most substantial anti-Moscow effort since Trump's return.
Vote count 262-159; official bill name 'Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026'; critics warn power could target US allies.
Bill passed Senate last month; targets Russia's energy sector by punishing largest oil/gas buyers to cut war revenue.
stories.line: House passed Russia sanctions legislation and a bill limiting data-center utility costs passed to consumers.

stories.title: Trump demands Kennedy Center rename, center goes dark as judge seeks explanation
new_facts: Introduces new actor 'Beatty' who is reportedly fighting back against Trump's Kennedy Center push
Federal judge blocked Kennedy Center board from adding a Trump tribute; Trump threatens to have building 'ripped down'
Board voted Tuesday to close the building despite the court order; Trump repeats 'ripped down' threat at NC rally
Kennedy Center physically closed: lights off, doors locked at 6pm Tuesday, bike racks stacked as barriers; judge demands answers
stories.line: Trump demanded the Kennedy Center be renamed after him; the center closed temporarily and a judge is now questioning the closure.

stories.title: McConnell requires staff guidance during farm bill vote as age and health concerns resurface
new_facts: New story: McConnell, 84, filmed freezing in Senate committee after 3-month absence since June 14 hospitalization
McConnell missed most of hearing but cast deciding vote advancing the farm bill
McConnell appeared wheelchair-bound and struggled to speak, needing guidance during the meeting
stories.line: Senate Republican leader McConnell, 84, showed difficulty speaking and required staff guidance during a farm bill procedural vote.

stories.title: Democrats meet with El-Sayed, shelving public feud before midterms
new_facts: New story: Democratic senators meet with Michigan Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed, set aside Israel rifts ahead of midterms.
Names Schumer as meeting El-Sayed at DSCC headquarters; notes primary wounds may not be healed.
Kamala Harris will campaign with El-Sayed in Michigan.
Adds that Harris endorsed El-Sayed after his primary win; Trump beat Harris there by under 2 points in 2024.
stories.line: Democratic Party leadership meets with Michigan gubernatorial candidate Abdul El-Sayed after months of public conflict, signaling party unity ahead of midterms.
